name: isocan
description: An isomorphic canvas: one 2.5D surface, driven from a web app and a terminal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @isocan/server" "npm run dev -w @isocan/web"

//: The runtime deps the CLI needs are declared HERE as well as in packages/cli, so that `npm i -g github:dglazkov/isocan` (no publishing) resolves them: a git install installs the root package only. The file: specs make the workspaces resolvable the same way in a checkout and in an install.
